gate_exit_from_ward.prompt: Concept art for a contemporary AAA open-world game, photorealistic real-time environment, eye-level view from inside a desert oasis colony on an alien desert planet, looking west through a fortified gate cut into a 3 metre tall sandstone-block city wall. The gate is framed by two steel-armoured reinforced concrete piers with worn yellow-black hazard stripes at the base, bolted riveted steel plates, and a walk-on steel I-beam gantry bridge across the top with railings, carrying a large stencilled olive-drab sign reading WEST GATE and two floodlights and an amber beacon. Olive militia banners with a bone-white wall-and-spire emblem hang on the piers. A heavy sliding steel gate leaf, olive paint with welded patches, is parked open along the outside of the wall on a ground rail. Beyond the gate a cracked concrete ramp with tyre marks descends to a desert checkpoint: a converted olive-drab shipping container guard post with an issue window and awning shutter, a sagging tan shade cloth canopy on poles, sandbag walls, a raised yellow-black boom barrier, concrete jersey barriers, a trailer-mounted light tower, and a training range with steel plates in front of an earth berm. Warm late-afternoon sun, long shadows, dust in the air, layered desert mountains in the distance, restrained cyan technology accents. Believable scale, grounded materials, no people
